messages:
Jess (Sales): Heads up — Nimbus Health sent an RFI and wants the attachments + capability matrix by EOD Thursday. Can someone own packaging the attachments and a short exec summary?

Omar (SE): I can do the capability matrix. Need to know which model variants we should list (hosted vs dedicated vs private).

Rachel (Solutions): For Nimbus, they asked about HSM/KMS, on-prem option, and latency SLOs. I think list both hosted (r-infer-latest) and private (v1.3-onprem) with notes on latency ranges.

Tom (Product): Note: v1.3-onprem is still in private beta — we can include it but mark as "by request" and reference the Private deployment checklist.

Prateek (AE): Also they asked for pricing bands for a 3-month POC (100k tokens/day) — can someone give a ballpark unit cost for dedicated vs hosted? I can convert to their expected monthly spend.

Omar (SE): Ballpark: hosted ~ $0.0009/token (generation) + embeddings priced separately. Dedicated depends on reserved capacity — estimate $Xk/mo for the GPUs they need. I'll add a pricing section with ranges and a note: "non-binding estimate".

Lisa (Security): We should not attach the HSM network diagram until NDA is signed. We can include the KMS/HSM compliance table (SOC2, ISO27001, FedRAMP status) and a redacted diagram. sec-bot: Security questionnaire added to thread: https://redwood.internal/rfis/1863456789/questionnaire

Jess (Sales): Good call. Nimbus is mid-enterprise; they usually sign NDA quickly but call it out. Can we include a short exec summary (1 page) highlighting: deployment options, SLAs, POC scope, and key ask list?

Rachel (Solutions): I'll draft the exec summary. Quick outline in matrix form:

```
Capabilities,Hosted, Dedicated, Private
Model catalog,Curated open models,Pin to commit,Private models + air gap
Latency (typical),30-120ms,20-80ms,20-120ms
Data residency,Multi-region,Isolated pools,Customer VPC/on-prem
Security controls,Basic KMS + logging,Customer KMS + isolation,Full KMS/HSM + audit
Support,Standard,Priority,Enterprise + SRE runbook
```

Omar (SE): That looks good. I'll populate numeric latency ranges per model and include sample perf table.

Prateek (AE): Timeline: who can upload final attachments to the RFI folder? Customer expects a zip named Nimbus-RFI-2026-attachments.zip.

Jess (Sales): @Omar (SE) please own the capability matrix, @Rachel (Solutions) you own exec summary, @Lisa (Security) KMS/HSM compliance table + redaction note. I'll coordinate NDA and send the zip once we have the pieces.

Omar (SE): On it. ETA: tomorrow noon PDT. I'll include a short README listing files and contact points.

Lisa (Security): I'll drop the compliance table by EOD today and flag anything that needs legal review.

Tom (Product): Quick product note to include in attachments: fallback routing policy — how we degrade to a lower-cost variant during peak capacity. Adds confidence on reliability.

sec-bot: Reminder — attach the versioned capability_matrix.csv and mark sensitive diagrams as redacted. Audit entry created: RFI-1863456789.

Jess (Sales): Perfect. After upload I'll add the price ranges and the ask table (NDA, POC access, sample data). Thanks team :rocket:
